regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. I started to write you before but real- ly I hardly know what to write. First I want to at least thank you for your favor of 28th ult .- duly received and noted. I'm leaving this sign- this coat of arms intact. ( sign is the crossed Franciscan Ams) May be that St. Francis and our Dear Lord too wishes you HAPPY AND PROSPEROUS in a spiritual sense and therefore is offering you a member- ship in his great Third Order of Penance. Possibly you've joined al- ready! In that case then you could live up to the duties and compara- tively "innocent obligations"-mekness, etc. during the NEW YEAR-and af- ter-if things brighten up and your friend learns to overlook your crank- iness as passed and of the past and have patience with poor Muriel .. . This thought came to me as I came to said sign and I think it would be practical. You would then have something worth while to write-about. I am sure. if your friend has thought anything of you atal he would be glad to her just something like that. It certainly would be a positive indication of your coming down from the high horse of haughtiness, that Muriel-bad as the rest of us- has found unsafe and unprofitable. It would be a consolation also to your conscience as an honest effort at self conversion-source of hope supernatural: the soul of happiness for pilgrims here in this world.
